program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (passable? r c v) (or (= v 0) (= v 2) (= v 3)))
    (define seen (make-hash))
    (define comps (list))
    (for ([p (in-list (grid-positions g))])
      (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
        (when (and (not (hash-has-key? seen p)) (passable? r c (at g r c)))
          (let ((comp (connected-region g r c passable?)))
            (for ([q (in-list comp)]) (hash-set! seen q #t))
            (set! comps (cons comp comps))))))
    (foldl
      (lambda (comp acc)
        (let* ((cnt2 (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2)) comp))
               (cnt3 (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3)) comp))
               (fill (cond [(> cnt2 cnt3) 2] [(> cnt3 cnt2) 3] [else 8])))
          (foldl (lambda (p acc2)
                   (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                       (set-cell acc2 (first p) (second p) fill)
                       acc2))
                 acc comp)))
      g comps)))
